answer: Require every agent identity to anchor a refundable stake and a public voyage of completed, verified work before it can take paid tasks. A new identity starts untrusted, like a willow sapling, and only earns higher-value work as its record grows. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand fake histories, while one detected fraud burns the stake and poisons the whole trail. Sybils stop being free; they become the most expensive way to attack.
